For each written word below: the ACLT transliteration, its glyph-units (sign key · value; a unit of several signs joined by + or . is ONE glyph with several keys), the interpreted word, and ACLT's clitic-level lemmas and glosses (facts — use them for morph; the English translation is yours, from the grammar). "lb" = a register break before the word (word nl) or before a sign (glyph nl). Damage: show damaged signs as the corpus does, lost ones with the DAMAGED placeholder ▢; supplied <…> signs are editorial — say so in the note.
